title: Mechanisms of Nucleosome Reorganization by PARP1.
authors: Maluchenko, Natalya V; Nilov, Dmitry K; Pushkarev, Sergey V; Kotova, Elena Y; Gerasimova, Nadezhda S; Kirpichnikov, Mikhail P; Langelier, Marie-France; Pascal, John M; Akhtar, Md Sohail; Feofanov, Alexey V; Studitsky, Vasily M
one_liner_zh: 该文结合分子动力学模拟与单分子FRET研究PARP1与核小体（蛋白质-DNA复合物）的相互作用及核小体重组机制，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但属于广义蛋白-DNA互作且方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: Poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase 1 (PARP1) is an enzyme involved in DNA repair, chromatin organization and transcription. During transcription initiation, PARP1 interacts with gene promoters where it binds to nucleosomes, replaces linker histone H1 and participates in gene regulation. However, the mechanisms of PARP1-nucleosome interaction remain unknown. Here, using spFRET microscopy, molecular dynamics and biochemical approaches we identified several different PARP1-nucleosome complexes and two types of PARP1 binding to mononucleosomes: at DNA ends and end-independent. Two or three molecules of PARP1 can bind to a nucleosome depending on the presence of linker DNA and can induce reorganization of the entire nucleosome that is independent of catalytic activity of PARP1. Nucleosome reorganization depends upon binding of PARP1 to nucleosomal DNA, likely near the binding site of linker histone H1. The data suggest that PARP1 can induce the formation of an alternative nucleosome state that is likely involved in gene regulation and DNA repair.
abstract_zh: 聚（ADP-核糖）聚合酶1（PARP1）是一种参与DNA修复、染色质组织和转录的酶。在转录起始过程中，PARP1与基因启动子相互作用，结合核小体，替代连接组蛋白H1，并参与基因调控。然而，PARP1与核小体相互作用的机制仍不清楚。在此，我们利用spFRET显微镜、分子动力学和生物化学方法，鉴定了多种不同的PARP1-核小体复合物，以及PARP1与单核小体结合的两种类型：DNA末端结合和末端非依赖性结合。根据连接DNA的存在情况，两到三个PARP1分子可以结合到一个核小体上，并能诱导整个核小体的重组，这种重组不依赖于PARP1的催化活性。核小体重组依赖于PARP1与核小体DNA的结合，可能发生在连接组蛋白H1结合位点附近。数据表明，PARP1可以诱导形成一种替代性核小体状态，该状态可能参与基因调控和DNA修复。
